title: Process Control Limit Transfer: Statistical Process Control Charts for Detecting AI Agent Behavioral Drift

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: SPC provides interpretable, statistically grounded alerts with known false alarm rates. Unlike LLM monitors, SPC alerts come with confidence bounds. Genuinely novel application of mature methodology with clear safety benefit.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: SPC charts are taught in undergraduate statistics. scipy and numpy make implementation trivial. No ML training required. Computing control limits from benign trajectories and plotting Shewhart charts is basic data science. Ideal for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined: compute control limits from 100 benign trajectories for 5 metrics, test on malicious trajectories. Could be narrowed to 3 metrics for safety. Clear deliverable: control charts and detection results. Feasible within 30 hours.
